fields.name: Players
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1D93BE0 inserts 2-byte ids (bg3.exe+0x796C40, the int16 set insert also used for player sets in bg3.exe+0x1D34EC0) taken from an Array of shorts at +0x10/+0x1C of a 0x20-byte event component; the later loops look up a player index (0..3) as a short in this set.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.evidence: Entry constructor bg3.exe+0x1D94D70 (stride 0x38) zeroes +0..+0x2F, writes 0x41700000 (15.0) at +0x30 and a 16-bit 0 at +0x34; bg3.exe+0x1D93BE0 subtracts the frame delta every frame (clamped at 0) unless Paused is set.

fields.name: field_34
fields.evidence: Constructor writes a 16-bit 0 at +0x34; bg3.exe+0x1D93BE0 sets this byte to 1 for entries whose Players contain the player matched to a Guid of a one-frame event (Guid compared with a 4-entry table at bg3.exe+0x6251EB0).

fields.name: Paused
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1D93BE0 sets +0x35 of every entry to 1 when any element of a system-wide list has a non-zero counter; the Timeout countdown is skipped while it is set.

fields.name: Transitions
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1D93BE0 (ecl::TimelineFadeTransitionSystem update; registration bg3.exe+0x732C50 lists the component as written, callback bg3.exe+0x75BED0) fetches the singleton with stride 0x40, looks up 16-byte keys hashed as qword0 ^ qword1 (bg3.exe+0x5CA2A0), inserts through bg3.exe+0x1D94BF0 and addresses values as +0x30 + index * 0x38; removal through bg3.exe+0x1D949B0. Keys come from the first 16 bytes of 0x20- and 0x10-byte timeline event components (a timeline Guid). Probe: empty. The macOS build names the container ls::HashMap<ls::Guid, ecl::timeline::TimelineFadeTransition> (RemoveNode instantiation) and its value storage ls::IndexedStorage<ecl::timeline::TimelineFadeTransition>; the struct keeps that game name.

open_questions: field_34: set when a per-player event arrives for a player of the transition - likely 'fade finished/acknowledged'; not named. Names Players/Timeout/Paused inferred.
Paused: the condition that sets it (a list at world storage DAT_146348E50, elements 0x40 bytes) was not resolved to a component name.
second_pass: Settled: Windows bg3.exe+0x1D93BE0 (lookup/insert/remove with 16-byte keys, values at +0x30 stride 0x38) and the entry constructor bg3.exe+0x1D94D70 (48-byte set, float 15.0 at +0x30, two bytes at +0x34) fix every offset; macOS names the map HashMap<Guid, ecl::timeline::TimelineFadeTransition>.
